alt: A short film with no voice, with music, in four loops of two and a half seconds. At a small dark pink-room table, an ink-black figure and a royal blue figure with white eyes lean left and right together. Each loop adds one thing: first a red object, a cup, appears on the table, then a plant appears on the right, then balloons appear on the left with both figures narrowing their eyes. The text stays: something changes every loop. Spot it.
